summary: Stick fights, parkour, combos & weapons vs zombies! Action platformer offline.
description:
Survive the zombie apocalypse in Stick vs Zombies, the most addictive 2D action platformer out there! Epic stick fights, real parkour, brutal combos. Grab your weapons and prove a simple stick figure can take down an entire army.

🧟 EPIC STICK FIGHTS VS ZOMBIE HORDES
Every stage is a non-stop stick fight against endless zombie hordes. Shoot, slash, smash. Pick your weapon and show how a real zombie killer fights. Brutal melee combat mixed with frantic shooting action across dozens of handcrafted platformer levels.

⚡2D ACTION + PARKOUR AT FULL SPEED
Climb platforms, hang from ledges, leap across rooftops, slide under obstacles. Parkour movement is what separates survivors from another zombie in the horde. Master the moves, chain them together, and turn every level into a high-speed fight.

🥊 COMBOS AND A DEVASTATING ARSENAL
Master melee combos and unlock a huge arsenal of weapons: pistols, shotguns, blades, explosives and more. Each weapon changes how you approach a stick fight, so experiment and find your style. Strategy + reflexes = victory.

👹 DIFFERENT ZOMBIES, DIFFERENT THREATS
From slow shamblers to fast runners to massive boss zombies. Every wave brings new threats. Learn each zombie type, adapt your strategy, and master the stick fight against them all. Some zombies need brute force, others need parkour finesse.

🏆 DAILY CHALLENGES — COMPETE WITH THE WORLD
A brand-new daily challenge drops every 24 hours, the same level for every player on the planet. Beat it, climb the global leaderboard, and prove you're the best stick fighter on Earth. Miss the day and you miss your shot at the top. Daily challenges reset everyday.

🎉 ALWAYS NEW — EVENTS, STAGES, CONSTANT UPDATES
Stick vs Zombies is constantly evolving. Limited-time events bring exclusive zombies, weapons and rewards you won't find anywhere else. New stages drop regularly to keep the apocalypse fresh. There's always something new to come back to. Never the same game twice.

🎮 PLAY ONLINE OR OFFLINE
No internet? No problem. Play offline anywhere: on the bus, in line, on a plane. When online, climb the global leaderboards, compete in daily challenges, and prove you're the best zombie killer out there.

📱 RUNS ON OLD PHONES
Stick vs Zombies is built to run smooth on any Android device — old phones, new phones, low-end or flagship. Action platformer with no lag, even on entry-level hardware. Small download, big game.

🏆 WHY PLAY
✔️ Dozens of 2D action platformer levels with handcrafted design
✔️ Real stick fights — not just button mashing
✔️ Addictive stick figure combat — easy to learn, hard to master
✔️ True parkour movement: climb, leap, run
✔️ Massive weapon variety: melee, ranged, explosive
✔️ Multiple zombie types and challenging bosses
✔️ Daily challenges with global leaderboard competition
✔️ Regular content updates and limited-time events
✔️ Full offline mode — no data needed to keep playing
✔️ Cloud save + global online leaderboards
✔️ Simple touch controls, hardcore gameplay depth
✔️ Kill time on the go or chase the world record

💡 PRO TIP
The best zombie killers don't just shoot — they parkour out of trouble, chain melee combos, and time their stick fights perfectly. Every level rewards skill, not luck.
Survive the zombie apocalypse. Master the stick fights. Master the platforms. Master the daily challenge.

Conquer the leaderboards. Download Stick vs Zombies now and prove a stick figure can save the world.

A relentless 2D action platformer with stick figures, zombies, parkour, melee combat, weapons, daily challenges and frequent updates. Built for offline play, optimized for any Android device.
